Anchor Point Swing.name: Anchor Point Swing
Anchor Point Swing.description: The user sticks a strip to a sound beam, railing or wall above them and swings across a street-wide gap. They may release at the far side and land on their feet before the end of their next turn. A weak anchor tears loose, and the user cannot change direction in midair without firing a second line to another surface. Strain: moderate.
